rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment The response is well coordinated and responsive to context, needs and gaps
rows.ne:
खण्ड 1: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
प्रतिकार्य राम्रोसँग समन्वय गरिएको छ र यसले सन्दर्भ, आवश्यकता र कमीहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्छ।
rows.bt:
Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
The response is well coordinated and addresses the context, needs and gaps.

rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors

rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the program.
rows.note: Revised to use the exact supplied T093 activity label. This is an unreviewed candidate; language and domain review remain pending.

rows.en: 1.1. List three actions you can take to strengthen MHPSS coordination in your region.

rows.bt: 1.1. List three actions you can take to strengthen MHPSS coordination in your area.

rows.en: 1.2. MHPSS needs assessments
rows.ne: 1.2. MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: 1.2. Assessment of MHPSS needs

rows.en: Discuss the following points and outline any steps that are needed to conduct and make effective use of MHPSS needs assessments.
rows.ne: निम्न बुँदाहरूमा छलफल गर्नुहोस् र MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्न तथा त्यसको प्रभावकारी उपयोग गर्न आवश्यक कदमहरूको रूपरेखा तयार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Discuss the following points and outline the steps needed to assess MHPSS needs and make effective use of that assessment.

rows.en: • When was the most recent MHPSS needs assessment in your region (if any)?
rows.ne: • तपाईंको क्षेत्रमा सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा कहिले गरिएको थियो (यदि कुनै गरिएको छ भने)?
rows.bt: • When was the most recent assessment of MHPSS needs carried out in your area (if any has been carried out)?

rows.en: • How have the findings shaped your programming (if at all)?
rows.ne: • निष्कर्षहरूले तपाईंको कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनलाई कसरी दिशा दिएका छन् (यदि कुनै प्रभाव परेको छ भने)?
rows.bt: • How have the findings guided your programme formulation and implementation (if there has been any effect)?

rows.en: • Does the assessment need to be updated?
rows.ne: • के लेखाजोखा अद्यावधिक गर्न आवश्यक छ?
rows.bt: • Does the assessment need to be updated?

rows.en: • Are there any groups whose needs have not been assessed?
rows.ne: • के कुनै समूहका आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गरिएको छैन?
rows.bt: • Are there any groups whose needs have not been assessed?

rows.en: • If you are not aware of any assessments, check with others if any MHPSS needs assessments are available and make a plan to review them.
rows.ne: • यदि तपाईंलाई कुनै लेखाजोखाबारे जानकारी छैन भने, MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा उपलब्ध छ कि छैन भनेर अरूसँग बुझ्नुहोस् र उपलब्ध लेखाजोखाको समीक्षा गर्ने योजना बनाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • If you do not know of any assessments, ask others whether an assessment of MHPSS needs is available and make a plan to review the available assessments.

rows.en: • If you know of assessments but have not reviewed them, consider steps you can take to access and review the assessments, and adapt your programming to identified needs.
rows.ne: • यदि तपाईंलाई लेखाजोखाबारे जानकारी छ तर तिनको समीक्षा गर्नुभएको छैन भने, ती लेखाजोखा प्राप्त गर्न र तिनको समीक्षा गर्न तथा पहिचान गरिएका आवश्यकताअनुसार आफ्नो कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा परिमार्जन गर्न तपाईंले चाल्न सक्ने कदमहरू विचार गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • If you know of assessments but have not reviewed them, consider the steps you can take to obtain and review those assessments and to modify your programme formulation and implementation according to the identified needs.

rows.en: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes MHPSS programmes are well designed, monitored and evaluated and workers are supported
rows.ne:
खण्ड 2: सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अवयवहरू
MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, अनुगमन र मूल्याङ्कन राम्रोसँग गरिन्छ र कार्यकर्तालाई सहयोग गरिन्छ।
rows.bt:
Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
The design, monitoring and evaluation of the MHPSS programme are carried out well, and workers are supported.
rows.note: The source describes essential components; अनिवार्य and the back-translation introduce mandatory status. The revision expresses essential necessity without asserting a mandate. The source refers to MHPSS programmes in the plural, whereas the back-translation makes the design, monitoring and evaluation statement about a single MHPSS programme.

rows.en: Section 3: MHPSS programme activities

rows.bt: Section 3: MHPSS programmatic activities

rows.en: Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne:
मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने
3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने
3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने
rows.bt:
Orient parties involved in humanitarian work and community members to MHPSS
3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members to MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and action
3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.note: Preserves the repeated opening phrase and both activity codes. Activity labels follow T098 and T099 verbatim. The psychosocial support skills wording is reused from the supplied unreviewed T099 candidate, cited to MAN PDF p29 and PRIOR-SUM-29OCT2026 p.2 row 90; no clinical validation is claimed.

rows.en: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces Provide focused support for people impaired by distress or mental health conditions 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: स्वसहयोग सुदृढ गर्ने र समुदायहरूलाई सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने। 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने। 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने। 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने। 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने। 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने। 3.8 शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने। 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने। तनाव वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाका कारण दैनिक कार्यमा असर परेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई केन्द्रित सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने। 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities. 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being. 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities. 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers. 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being. 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children. 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education sector staff and strengthen their capacity to support children. 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls. Provide focused support to people whose daily functioning has been affected by stress or mental health conditions. 3.10 Provide mental health services as part of general health services.
rows.note: Frozen wording is retained: T008 renders distress as stress and specifies impairment of daily functioning, whereas the source does not equate distress with stress or specify that domain of impairment; T054 and T106 restrict girls to adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without that age restriction. bt-divergence: Frozen T008 renders distress as stress and restricts impairment to daily functioning; the source neither equates distress with stress nor specifies that domain of impairment. Frozen T054/T106 restrict girls to adolescent girls, while the source has no such age restriction. Frozen T107 renders mental health care as mental health services. These frozen forms are retained.

rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने। 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner. 3.12 Start or strengthen arrangements for psychological interventions.
rows.note: Frozen T108 is retained, but its wording denotes people affected by the violence and can include indirectly affected people, whereas the source specifies survivors who themselves experienced sexual violence or intimate partner violence. bt-divergence: Frozen T108 describes people affected by sexual violence and intimate partner violence, potentially including indirectly affected people; the source specifies survivors who directly experienced the violence. The frozen form is retained.

rows.en: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne:
3.13 केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt:
3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services.
3.14 Protect and care for people in mental hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Reuses the supplied activity labels verbatim apart from final punctuation. Institutional terminology remains an unreviewed cited candidate.

rows.en: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.ne: खण्ड 4: विशिष्ट परिवेशका लागि गतिविधिहरू र विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: Section 4: Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.note: Settings is rendered as circumstances. Restore the reference to the particular settings or contexts in which activities take place.

rows.en: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS considerations and support into clinical case management for infectious diseases
rows.ne: 4.1 सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र सहयोग एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS-related considerations and support into the clinical case management of communicable diseases.
rows.note: Frozen T112 and T242 are retained, but सरुवा रोग denotes communicable diseases, whereas the source specifies infectious diseases; these categories are not necessarily coextensive. bt-divergence: Frozen T112/T242 render infectious diseases as communicable diseases. Infectious diseases are not necessarily transmissible between hosts, so the categories are not coextensive. The frozen forms are retained.

rows.bt: 4.2 Provide mental health and psychosocial support to people deprived of liberty.

rows.bt: 4.1. Considering the overall MSP, which 3 actions will be your immediate priorities as you move forward now.
